title: finding(console): after the System Hub card wall retired (objectui#3743), `system/audit-log`, `system/ai-approvals` and `/apps/:app/developer` have no in-app entry in objectui or in the framework navigation
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it. The fix may land in objectui (console routes) or in the framework's Setup navigation (objectstack `platform-objects`), and routing between the two is triage's call.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) at the ACCEPT of objectui#3743 (PR objectui#10507, comment `5827582462`). The at-tier contract review of that PR measured it. The PR did not disclose it. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

Ruling `5230004004` retired the bespoke System Hub card wall, with navigation as the single source of truth. PR objectui#10507 (merged `9eea12a2b`) did that. The wall's 13 cards, however, were the **only** in-app producer of three routes that still exist:

| route | page | in-app producers now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `/apps/:app/system/audit-log` | `AuditLogPage` | 0. The framework `nav_audit_logs` targets the object `sys_audit_log`, which is a different URL |
| `/apps/:app/system/ai-approvals` | `AiPendingActionsPage` | 0 |
| `/apps/:app/developer` | `DeveloperHubPage` | 0. The framework `developer:*` entries are Studio `componentRef`s to the sub-pages, not to the hub |

Reading: a `git grep` of each path over `packages/app-shell/src` and `apps/console/src` (non-test) finds only the three `Route` declarations. A grep of objectstack `origin/main` `packages/platform-objects` finds no navigation entry that targets any of the three URLs.

⇒ The pages are still reachable by typed URL or bookmark, but no link leads to them. That is a discoverability regression the retirement caused by design, since the wall was the navigation for them.

## What has to be decided (for triage, not a ruling)

For each page, one of:
- (a) give it a navigation entry in the framework's Setup navigation, so the navigation stays the single source of truth;
- (b) retire the console page, if the object view or Studio already covers it (the audit log object `sys_audit_log` has its own entry).

`AuditLogPage` versus the `sys_audit_log` object view, and `DeveloperHubPage` versus the Studio `developer:*` entries, may be duplicates. Measure that first.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (the search API answers 403 here), oldest updated 2026-09-18T10:20Z. Pattern `(AuditLogPage|AiPendingActionsPage|DeveloperHubPage) … (nav|entry|reach|producer|orphan|link)` ⇒ 0 hits. Lit control `SystemHubPage` ⇒ 3 hits. ⇒ No duplicate.

Dedupe words: `audit-log page no nav entry` · `ai-approvals orphan route` · `DeveloperHubPage no producer` · `system hub retired orphaned pages`
